writeup: The WORX WA4092 gutter cleaning kit turns a leaf blower into a gutter cleaner you can use from the ground, with about 11 feet of reach and a universal adapter that fits most blowers. Woot has it new for $17.99 with a 90-day Woot warranty, versus $51.62 at Home Depot and $59.99 at Ace Hardware. Limit 10 per order.
